metadata.title: The Neon Dragon of Pixel Harbour
metadata.subtitle: A pocket gamebook adventure across Hong Kong
metadata.author: Original story
metadata.description: ORIGINAL CONTENT. Not taken or adapted from any published gamebook. A choose-your-path adventure across a pixel-art Hong Kong: Temple Street, the Star Ferry, the MTR, a grumpy red taxi, Causeway Bay, Man Mo Temple, dim sum, a cha chaan teng, the Peak Tram and harbour fireworks, with eleven zodiac animals to meet.

trackers.label: ZODIAC COLLECTION
trackers.description: Meet the eleven zodiac animals out tonight. The twelfth, the Dragon, is busy with the moon: she only joins a hero who has met all eleven, at the winning finale. Only one route through the book meets them all.

intro.title: Insert Coin
text: Rain drums on the windows of the Golden Joystick, the tiniest arcade in Mong Kok. Neon signs buzz outside, painting the puddles pink and blue, and somewhere a minibus horn plays a tune that is definitely not a real tune.

You, {{name}}, have five arcade tokens jingling in your pocket, and there's one machine you have never seen before. It sits in the back corner, humming softly. On its screen, a dragon made of glowing lights is curled around the words NEON DRAGON. Underneath, letters flash: THE PEARL IS LOST. PLAYER ONE, PLEASE HELP.
Funny. You're sure it wasn't there yesterday. You're also sure it just winked at you.

illustration.alt: A glowing arcade machine in a rainy Mong Kok arcade

choices.label: Drop a token into the slot
Ask Auntie Lam about the strange machine first

auntie.title: Auntie Lam
text: Auntie Lam runs the arcade. She is small and quick and never stops snacking. Today she is guarding a box of warm egg tarts behind the counter like a dragon guarding gold.

"That old thing?" she says, squinting. "It only switches on when someone brave walks in. Last time was... hmm, 1986?" She pushes an egg tart into your hand, then digs in her handbag and pulls out a battered blue card. "Take my spare Octopus card. Beep in, beep out, never queue for change."

"Three tips," she says, counting on her fingers. "One: never spend your LAST token. No tokens, no game. Two: if you meet a robot, remember everybody gets grumpy when they're hungry. Three: if you're ever in Central, my old friend Pig runs the best cha chaan teng on the island. Tell Pig that Auntie Lam sent you."

choices.label: Drop a token into the Neon Dragon machine

portal.title: Pixel Harbour
text: The token clinks. The screen flares so brightly you have to shut your eyes, and the floor drops away like the first second of a rollercoaster.

When you open your eyes, you're standing on a waterfront made of chunky square pixels. In front of you is Hong Kong... but not quite. The skyscrapers are built from glowing blocks, the harbour sparkles in eight colours, and the moon is a perfect pixel circle.

A plump orange cat with a dumpling-shaped face sits beside you. "Finally! Player One!" it says. "I'm Siu Mai. Yes, like the dumpling. No, you may not eat me. The Glitch Gremlins stole the Neon Dragon's Pearl of Light and took it to the Sky Tower on the Peak, across the harbour. If it isn't back by midnight, every light here goes out. For good."

"Rules of this game," Siu Mai adds. "Your Pixel Power is your timer: every move uses one, so don't dawdle. If it, your Energy or your Luck hits zero, you're trapped in the game forever. Run out of tokens and you're OUT. Oh, and the zodiac animals are all out tonight, except the Dragon, who's busy helping the moon. Each one you meet gives you a bit of Pixel Power. Meet all eleven and the Dragon herself might join you at the end: all twelve! Nobody's ever managed it."

"One more thing," Siu Mai whispers. "The gremlins love dressing up as zodiac animals to trick heroes. Look closely before you pick a path! A gremlin in a costume always slips up somewhere: glowing green eyes, a zip, the wrong noise, or a whiff of engine oil. A real animal does real animal things."
"So," says Siu Mai, "how are we crossing the harbour?"

illustration.alt: A pixel-art harbour skyline at night with an orange cat

market.title: Temple Street Night Market
text: Paper lanterns sway above a street packed with stalls. A pixel fish-ball seller flips sizzling snacks, a robot grandma sells socks that change colour every few seconds, and a fortune-telling parrot shouts "NEXT!" at nobody in particular.

Three lantern stalls glow side by side, each run by a white rabbit. One rabbit nibbles a carrot, her pink nose twitching non-stop. The other stands very still, and under its hood its eyes glow a spooky green.

Under the stalls, three rats in tiny waistcoats are counting coins. One squeaks happily with every coin. The other one's long tail looks oddly like a black plastic cable, and the air around it smells of engine oil. And a claw machine stuffed with prizes has something small and brass glinting at the bottom.

At the end of the row, a cart with nobody minding it has a hand-painted sign: FREE SAMPLES! SUPER FISH BALLS! +5 ENERGY!!! The fish balls glow a spooky green and the cart smells of engine oil. Next door, a herbal tea shop with shiny bronze gourds on the counter sells bitter 24-herb tea. A sign says: FIXES ANY BAD TUMMY.
In a dark alley, a grinning gremlin beckons. "Psst! Shortcut to the Peak! Totally safe!" Siu Mai's fur stands on end.
A third rabbit stands at a purple lantern stall. Its stiff cardboard ears are tied on with string.
A third rat counts coins beside a blue box. Its whiskers are wire, and its tail clicks like a wind-up toy.

illustration.alt: A pixel night market with lanterns

fishball_cart.title: Free Sample!
text: You take a fish ball on a stick. It's warm, it glows, and it hums very quietly, like a fridge. A sticker on the stick says: SUPER FISH BALL! +5 ENERGY!!! Underneath, in tiny letters: MADE BY G. GREMLIN.

Siu Mai sniffs it, and every hair on its tail stands up. "Glowing green," it says slowly. "Now, where have I seen glowing green before? I'd keep that in your pocket if I were you. Way down at the bottom."

illustration.alt: A glowing green fish ball on a stick at an unattended street cart

choices.label: Pocket it and head back into the market

herbal_shop.title: 24-Herb Tea
text: The herbalist taps a shiny bronze gourd and pours a stream of dark brown tea into a takeaway cup. It smells like a forest that's been boiled for a week.

"Twenty-four herbs," she says. "Bitter as anything. It fixes a bad tummy, a dodgy snack, even gremlin poison. And if you're feeling fine, it'll still perk you up." She snaps on a lid so you can drink it later.

illustration.alt: A herbal tea shop with shiny bronze gourds

choices.label: Thank her and head back into the market

lantern_stall.title: The Rabbit's Lanterns
text: The lantern seller is a white rabbit in a red jacket, with ears so tall they keep bumping the lanterns. Every lantern on her stall is shaped like a rabbit too. "Family business," she says proudly.

"Looking for the zodiac Dragon?" she asks. "Ha! She's off helping the moon get perfectly round for Mid-Autumn. Busiest week of her year. She leaves the Neon Dragon in charge of the city lights." She presses a mooncake into your paws. "For energy. Heroes forget to eat."
"Light shows the hidden things," she adds, tapping a lantern. "Keep one close in dark places. Tunnels, especially."

illustration.alt: A rabbit selling glowing rabbit lanterns at the night market

then.message: Zodiac friend found: RABBIT! +2 Pixel Power

rat.title: The Rat's Counting House
text: The rat is surrounded by towers of coins and fish balls. "One, two, three... oh, bother. I've lost count AGAIN." She pushes her tiny glasses up her nose. "Clever-looking hero! Count these for me?"
You count: forty-two fish balls and seven coins. The rat beams and pays you two tokens. "The Rat always pays her debts. First in the zodiac, first to pay!"
"Oh, and I found this in a puddle," she says, holding up a slightly soggy Octopus card. "Yours for two tokens, if you need one."

illustration.alt: A rat in a waistcoat counting coins

then.message: Zodiac friend found: RAT! +2 Pixel Power

claw.title: The Claw Machine
text: You drop in a token. Music plays. The claw whirrs down... down... down... towards the tiny brass glint.
Remember: claw machines are built so the house usually wins!

test.label: CLAW MACHINE GAMBLE
test.prompt: Roll two dice to see what the claw does.

failure.text: The claw wobbles... your token is gone, and so is some of your luck.

seven.text: BONK! The claw swings round and bops you on the head. There goes half your luck!

claw_win.title: Got It!
text: The claw closes with a CLUNK and lifts out a little brass key shaped like a dragon's claw. A paper tag hangs from it: VAULT. KEEP AWAY FROM GREMLINS.
The rabbit whistles. "Lucky! Nobody has won that in a hundred years."

choices.label: Back to the market

claw_lose.title: So Close!
text: The claw grabs a rubber duck, wobbles, and drops it. Then it slowly drops nothing at all, as if it's laughing at you.
Careful. Those tokens don't grow on trees.

choices.label: Try again (1 token)
choices.lockedHint: Needs 1 token

fortune_bird.title: The Fortune Parrot
text: The parrot wears tiny round sunglasses. It looks you up and down, sighs dramatically, and pulls three cards out of a box with its beak.
BEWARE THE SALE THAT IS TOO GOOD TO BE TRUE. KEEP CALM AND MIND THE GAP. NEVER, EVER EAT EVERYTHING.
"That'll be one sunflower seed," says the parrot. You don't have one. "Fine. First one's free. NEXT!"

choices.label: Thank the parrot and look around

gremlin_alley.title: Shortcut? Short CUT!
text: The gremlin leads you down an alley, round a corner, round another corner and round a third corner, which somehow brings you back to the first corner. Then it giggles, picks your pocket and vanishes.
You stagger back into the market, tired and a token lighter. Siu Mai says nothing. Loudly.

choices.label: Back to the market (and NEVER trust a gremlin)
Follow the smell of the sea down to the pier
That's it. This is too spooky. Find a way home

lost_alleys.title: Lost in the Alleys
text: You follow the gremlin again. It giggles again. Corners again. More corners. So many corners.
By the time you find your way out, the clock has struck midnight and every light in Pixel Harbour has gone out. Somewhere a gremlin is laughing so hard it falls off a roof.
Fool me once, shame on the gremlin. Fool me twice...
All those corners used up your very last drop of Pixel Power. ★ 0.

illustration.alt: An arcade machine flashing INSERT COIN with a tiny hero trapped inside

pier.title: Star Ferry Pier
text: A green-and-white Star Ferry bobs at the pier, its paddle wheels made of spinning pixels. The captain is a large, sleepy toad in a captain's hat. "Crossing to Central," he croaks. "Tap your card or pay two tokens. Them's the rules."
At the next pier, a rusty purple ferry is tooting its horn. A sign says FREE RIDES!!! The crew are very short, very purple, and giggling.

illustration.alt: A pixel Star Ferry at a pier with the island skyline behind

sneak.title: Ribbit!
text: You tiptoe up the gangplank... and step right on the captain's foot.
"RIBBIT!" he bellows. He scoops you up and plops you back on the pier with a soggy SPLOSH. Siu Mai pretends not to know you.

wrong_ferry.title: The Gremlin Ferry
text: The purple ferry chugs out into the harbour... and goes round in a circle. Then another circle. The gremlin crew sing sea shanties very badly and charge you a token for "fuel".
Twenty dizzy circles later, they dump you back on the Kowloon pier. You're green, you're giddy, and you're exactly where you started.

illustration.alt: A purple ferry spinning in circles

choices.label: Wobble back to the pier

all_at_sea.title: All at Sea
text: The purple ferry chugs out again, but this time it doesn't come back. It sails right out past the islands, with the gremlins singing all the way.
Behind you, at the stroke of midnight, the lights of Pixel Harbour blink out one by one. "Free," sighs Siu Mai, "is never free."
The endless voyage drains your very last drop of Pixel Power. ★ 0.

illustration.alt: A tiny ferry far out at sea

ferry.title: Across the Harbour
text: The Star Ferry chugs across the sparkling harbour. Pixel fish leap alongside, and the city lights twinkle on the waves, though some of them flicker and go dark as you watch.

Halfway across, three small purple gremlins pop out of the water, giggling. The captain flicks out his long tongue (THWIP!) and they tumble back into the waves. "Pests," he grumbles from the wheelhouse. "Come in for a cup of something hot. The Ox is down below too."

Three doors lead off the deck. A trail of big, muddy hoofprints goes in through the wheelhouse door. The other door has a wonky sign, OX IN HERE, and from behind it something says: "Oink... I mean, MOO!"
A third door opens onto a storeroom. Cardboard horns poke through its curtain, but no hoofprints lead there.

illustration.alt: A pixel Star Ferry crossing the harbour

choices.label: Explore the cabins below the ferry deck
Lean over the rail to watch the gremlins

ferry_captain.title: The Wheelhouse
text: The wheelhouse smells of lemon tea and old maps. Down below, a huge, gentle ox in overalls keeps the engines running, shovelling pixels into the boiler without ever hurrying. "Slow and steady," the Ox rumbles, handing you a warm cup of soy milk. "Gets you there every time."

The captain slurps his tea like a drain. "Those gremlins took a shiny pearl up to the Sky Tower. Here." He presses something cold and shiny into your hand. "The Silver Whistle. One note makes any machine dance. And blow it on a pier, and a good dog will come running from a mile away."

illustration.alt: A friendly ox in overalls in the ferry's engine room

then.message: Zodiac friend found: OX! +2 Pixel Power

choices.label: Hop off at Central Pier

ferry_splash.title: Splosh!
text: You lean over the rail. A gremlin leans out of the water. You look at each other.
It blows a raspberry and flicks a whole wave over you. SPLOSH! By the time you've wrung out your socks, the ferry is bumping into Central Pier.

choices.label: Squelch off at Central Pier

taxi_rank.title: The Red Taxi
text: A red taxi screeches to a stop so close that its bumper kisses your shoes. The driver is a round man with a toothpick, a flat cap and eyebrows that have clearly been grumpy since 1979.
"Where to?" he barks. "Cross-harbour? Aiya. Cross-harbour means I have to come all the way BACK. Two tokens. Cash only. And don't wave your Octopus card at me. This taxi is older than your parents."

illustration.alt: A red Hong Kong taxi with a grumpy driver at night

choices.label: "Causeway Bay, please!" (2 tokens)
choices.lockedHint: Needs 2 tokens (cash only!)

choices.label: Back away slowly and find another way

taxi_ride.title: Cross-Harbour Grumbles
text: The taxi lurches off. The driver complains the whole way: about the traffic, the gremlins, the price of fish balls, his knees, and a PiGeon that looked at him funny in 2003.
The tunnel lights flicker green and purple; gremlins are messing with them. "See?" he grumbles. "Nobody fixes anything any more."

illustration.alt: A red taxi racing through the cross-harbour tunnel

choices.label: Agree with absolutely everything he says
Ask him to drive faster
Tell him he's the grumpiest driver in Hong Kong

taxi_agree.title: A Soft Centre
text: "Yes, terrible traffic." "Yes, fish balls are too expensive." "Yes, that PiGeon was very rude."

Slowly, the driver's eyebrows un-grump. At the kerb in Causeway Bay he hands you a milk sweet and an umbrella from under his seat. "Somebody left it. Rain's coming, I feel it in my knees. Don't tell anyone I was nice."

onEnter.message: The driver has a heart of gold (don't tell him).

choices.label: Climb out into Causeway Bay

taxi_faster.title: Racing Game Mode
text: "FASTER? Finally, someone who understands!" He drives like he's in a racing game: left, right, VROOM, screech, round a double-decker bus, past a very surprised gremlin.
He drops you at Causeway Bay in record time, looking happier than he has in years. You look green, and your legs are wobbly, but you're fine. Just a very bumpy ride. (-3 Energy.)

choices.label: Wobble out into Causeway Bay

taxi_rude.title: The Long Way Round
text: The driver's eyebrows shoot up into his cap. "GRUMPY? ME?" He takes the long way. The very long way. Past the airport. Twice.
Finally he drops you in Causeway Bay and points at the clock. "Scenic route. You're welcome." Being rude, it turns out, wastes a LOT of time. (-4 Pixel Power, -1 Energy, -1 Luck.)

onEnter.message: The very long way round! -4 Pixel Power. Rudeness is bad luck: -1 Luck

choices.label: Climb out into Causeway Bay, much later than planned

mtr_station.title: The MTR
text: You ride the escalator down, down, down into the MTR station. Everything is shiny and smells faintly of floor polish. A sign says: NO EATING. NO DRINKING. NO GREMLINS.
At the ticket gates, people beep through without slowing down. Siu Mai just walks underneath. "Cats ride free," it says smugly.

illustration.alt: A bright pixel MTR station

mtr_platform.title: Rush Hour
text: The platform is PACKED. Office workers, students, a grandma with a trolley full of oranges and a man carrying an entire fish tank all stand in neat queues behind the yellow line. Someone's elbow bumps you right in the ear.

A train whooshes in, stuffed so full that people are pressed against the glass like dumplings in a steamer. Ding-dong! "Please mind the gap." Siu Mai mutters, "Another one will be along in two minutes, you know."

illustration.alt: A crowded pixel MTR platform at rush hour

choices.label: Squeeze into the packed train
Let it go and wait for the next train

mtr_crush.title: Squashed!
text: You squeeze in. About forty more people squeeze in behind you. You're squashed between a backpack, a briefcase and the fish tank, with your face pressed against a poster about polite behaviour.
"Next station: Causeway Bay," says the voice. Oh no. You're stuck at the very back...

choices.label: Wriggle and DIVE for the doors as they close!
Stay put, ride on to Central and step out calmly

mtr_wait.title: The Next Train
text: Two minutes later, the next train glides in, almost empty. You get a seat! Siu Mai curls up on your lap and purrs.

Opposite you, an auntie with twelve shopping bags bonks a giggling bag with her umbrella. The giggling stops. "Next station: Causeway Bay. Please mind the gap." The seat is very comfy. Very, very comfy...
On the seat beside you, somebody has left a pair of chunky goggles with a sticky label: GREMLIN GOGGLES. SEES THROUGH ANY DISGUISE. Finders keepers!

choices.label: Step off at Causeway Bay, minding the gap
Stay on until Central
Close your eyes for just a teeny little nap

mtr_depot.title: End of the Line
text: You wake up with a snort. The train is empty, parked in a depot full of sleeping trains. A station worker in a hard hat shines a torch on you. "Missed your stop? Happens every night."
She walks you back along the platform and puts you on the right train, but it costs you a token for the extra journey, and Siu Mai will be telling this story for weeks.

illustration.alt: An empty MTR train in a depot

choices.label: Ride the right train to Central

mtr_gap.title: MIND THE GAP!
text: You dive. The doors snap shut behind you, but your foot slips into the gap between the train and the platform, and in Pixel Harbour, the gap is a glitch.
BZZZT! Half your pixels drain away into the gap like water down a plughole. The station voice says, very calmly, "Please mind the gap." Thanks, voice.

choices.label: Stumble up the stairs into Causeway Bay

central.title: Central
text: Central is a canyon of glittering towers. Walkways float between buildings like ribbons, people hurry everywhere at once, and an escalator climbs right up the side of the hill.

Three cafés on the corner both have a pig on the sign. One has green tiles and smells of sweet milk tea. At the other, a 'pig' waves at you from the door, and its curly tail is held on with a safety pin. Down on Central Pier, the water laps at the steps.
Up the steep old streets is Man Mo Temple. A dim sum restaurant clatters with trolleys. Ding-ding trams rattle past. And just up the road, the little red Peak Tram waits to climb the mountain.
At a third café with a red awning, a pig balances a painted paper cup on its face as a snout. The doorway smells of engine oil.
Beside a second kiosk, a third dog has perfectly dry paws and a shiny zipper down its back.

illustration.alt: The pixel towers of Central at night

then.message: Four arcade tokens glint in a crack in the pavement! +4 tokens

statue_square.title: Statue Square
text: Statue Square is a wide paved plaza between the glass towers, with a splashing fountain and a grand old domed courthouse that glows in the dark. A golden statue stands on top of the dome, holding a set of scales.
And the square belongs to the PiGeons. Hundreds of them, strutting, bobbing and cooing, their necks shimmering green and purple under the streetlights.

text.text: Then every PiGeon in the square stops. Turns. And sniffs. They have smelled your snacks. With a roar of wings, a grey cloud of PiGeons swoops down on you! They peck open your bag, gobble every last egg tart and bun, and leave you dizzy, flappy and covered in crumbs. (-2 Pixel Power, -2 Energy, -2 Luck.)

The PiGeons look you up and down, see that you have no buns and no egg tarts, and go straight back to their bobbing. One old PiGeon waddles past and mutters: "Coo. That tin robot up on the Peak? Coo. Goes all dizzy at a whistle, it does. Coo."
Where it was pecking, something glitters between the paving stones: a tiny, twinkling pixel star! You pick it up and it zooms into your star counter. (+1 bonus star, just for fun.)

"Auntie Lam sent you? Then it's on the house!" Pig sets down a milk tea and a pineapple bun with a fat slice of butter melting in the middle. (There's no pineapple in a pineapple bun. Pig says that's the best part.) "And one for the road."

man_mo.title: Man Mo Temple
text: Man Mo Temple is quiet. After the noise of the city, the quiet feels like a warm blanket. Giant spirals of incense hang from the ceiling like upside-down cones, slowly turning, and soft smoke drifts through the red-and-gold light.
People come here to wish for good studies and for courage. An elderly keeper is sweeping the floor with slow, careful strokes. He looks up and nods to you.

text.text: The keeper takes one look at your green face and wafts a curl of incense smoke towards you. You breathe it in. Your tummy stops gurgling, your head clears, and the poison fizzles away. (Poison cured!)

text: Your voice echoes round the temple. Everyone turns to look. Even Siu Mai flattens its ears and hides behind your legs.
The keeper doesn't get cross. He just puts a finger to his lips and smiles kindly, and somehow that makes you feel even sillier. This is a place for quiet.

man_mo_calm.title: The Calm Breath
text: You sit on a little wooden stool and watch the incense smoke curl upwards. The keeper sits beside you and shows you how to breathe: in slowly while the smoke rises, out slowly while it drifts. In... and out...
Your heart stops racing. Time seems to slow down, and your pixels glow a little brighter.
"A noisy mind loses its power," the keeper says softly. "A calm mind keeps it. Remember this when someone shouts at you."

Before you go, he hands you one thin stick of incense. You light it carefully, place it in the big bronze burner with both hands, and make a quiet wish for courage. The smoke curls up to join the spirals above.

causeway_bay.title: Causeway Bay
text: You pop out into Causeway Bay and the noise hits you like a wave: beeping crossings, chattering crowds, music from twenty shops at once. Neon signs stack up the buildings like a giant, glowing bookshelf, though some are flickering and going dark.

On top of the tallest sign sits a bird made of fire, keeping it alight with her own glow: you can feel her warmth on your face even from down here. On a smaller sign across the road sits a second 'fiery bird', but its flames are cold, flickering strips of light that buzz like a broken fridge. Over the road, the giant screen at Times Square shows the Gremlin King's face: "MIDNIGHT SALE! ALL LIGHTS 100% OFF!" And next to a bubble tea shop, a new shop flashes: GLITCH MEGA SALE. EVERYTHING FREE!!!
A third fiery bird perches on a shop roof. Its feathers are crumpled foil and smell of engine oil, with no warmth at all.

You scoop up the Pearl of Light. It feels warm, like holding a tiny sun. The Snake winks. "Take ssssome tokens too. The gremlins owe everyone."
"One more thing," hisses the Snake. "The only way up to the Dragon is through the Sky Tower door, and that big tin bully guards it. You'll have to get past Bolt-Bot. No sssneaking."

Blocking the tower door stands BOLT-BOT, the gremlins' guard: a rusty robot as tall as a bus, with a saucepan for a head. "HALT. NO. PLAYERS. ALLOWED. ESPECIALLY IF YOU DON'T HAVE AT LEAST 7 ZODIAC ANIMALS WITH YOU." Its tummy makes a long, sad rumble.

then.message: Zodiac friend found: GOAT! +2 Pixel Power

effects.message: Loulou taught you her secret climbing route! (High ground: +1 attack against Bolt-Bot)
Loulou winks: "Spotted a little dragon-claw door in the tunnel on the way up? It's only a hop back down. No need to ride all the way to the bottom!"

goat_climb.title: The High Ground
text: Hop on the bin. Spring to the lamp-post. Toes on the drainpipe. Never look down. You climb exactly the way Loulou showed you, right up to the stone ledge above the tower door.

Bolt-Bot is directly below you, scanning the path. It has no idea you're up here. The tower windows are all locked tight, so the only way in is still through that door, but now you've got the HIGH GROUND. (+1 attack in the duel.)

choices.label: Leap down on Bolt-Bot and start the duel!
choices.lockedHint: Needs at least 7 zodiac animals

choices.label: Climb back down and get ready some more

peak_climb.title: Wheee... Ow.
text: You tiptoe round the back of the tower and start climbing a drainpipe. You get surprisingly high. Then the drainpipe says "BEEP". It is not a drainpipe. It is Bolt-Bot's leg.
You slide all the way down on your bottom and land in a bush. "NICE. TRY," it booms. (If only you knew someone who was good at climbing...)

choices.label: Brush off the leaves and go back to the door

bot_dance.title: Robot Boogie
text: You blow one bright silver note. Bolt-Bot freezes. Then its feet start tapping. In seconds it's doing the robot (badly), spinning round and round in front of the door.
"I. CANNOT. STOP," it wails. When the music in its head finally stops, it wobbles back into the doorway, dizzy and dented. It still won't let you pass, but it'll start the duel with 4 less HP!

choices.label: Challenge the dizzy robot to the duel!
choices.lockedHint: Needs at least 7 zodiac animals

choices.label: Get ready some more

bot_snack.title: Snack Break
text: Bolt-Bot sniffs. Its saucepan head tilts. You break your snack in half and sit down on the step together for a quick picnic. Its eyes turn into two pink hearts.
"DELICIOUS. THANK. YOU." Then it stands up and cracks its knuckles. "BUT. RULES. ARE. RULES. NOBODY. PASSES. WITHOUT. A. DUEL." At least you're full of energy now. (+4 Energy before the fight.)

choices.label: Challenge Bolt-Bot to the duel!
choices.lockedHint: Needs at least 7 zodiac animals

choices.label: Get ready some more

bot_battle.title: Boss Duel!
text: You raise your fists. Bolt-Bot raises its huge rubber-glove fists. Then its chest panel slides open with a hiss and its eyes flash red: TURBO MODE.
"BEEP BOOP. FINAL. BOSS. ACTIVATED. PREPARE. FOR. MEGA. BOPPING."

combat.intro: BOSS FIGHT! Turbo Bolt-Bot has ATTACK 8 and 10 HP, and its mega-bops knock off 3 Energy. Each round you both roll two dice and add your attack (your LUCK plus any boosts). Higher total lands a bop: you knock off 2 HP. It only accepts a duel from a hero with at least 7 zodiac friends. Friends and gear help: your zodiac crowd roars you on (+2 attack), the Phoenix Feather +1, the Lucky Horseshoe +1, Loulou's high ground +1, the Silver Whistle makes it start dizzy (4 less HP), a shared snack fills you up before the fight, and the duck Umbrella blocks 1 damage from every bop. This is the only way into the tower: RUN AWAY (back to the lookout, -3 Pixel Power) and you'll have to come back and fight. Careful: if your Energy hits 0, you're trapped in the game forever.

win.text: Turbo Bolt-Bot sparks, wobbles and topples over!

flee.label: RUN AWAY! (back to the lookout, -3 Pixel Power)

effects.message: You scramble back to the lookout. Bolt-Bot is still guarding the door: you'll have to come back and fight!

bot_beaten.title: Clang!
text: With one last bop, Turbo Bolt-Bot topples over with a mighty CLANG, its saucepan head spinning like a top. A few tokens roll out of its pocket.
"OKAY. OKAY. YOU. WIN," it says, and sits down for a little rest. The tower door swings open.

choices.label: Dash into the Sky Tower
You already have the Pearl: race up the tower stairs to the Neon Dragon!

tower_top.title: The Gremlin King
text: At the very top of the tower, in a room full of tangled wires and flashing screens, sits the Gremlin King. He is the size of a cat, wears a bottle-cap crown, and is juggling the Pearl of Light from hand to hand.

"A PLAYER?!" he shrieks. He takes a huge breath, puffs up like a balloon and lets out his most terrible attack: the GLITCH SCREEEEEAM! The screens crackle. The windows rattle. The sound tries to shake the pixels right out of you.

illustration.alt: A small purple gremlin king with a bottle-cap crown holding a glowing pearl

choices.label: Breathe slowly, like the temple keeper taught you
choices.lockedHint: Needs a calm mind (someone could teach you)

choices.label: Blow the Silver Whistle even louder
Cover your ears and hope for the best

king_scream.title: SCREEEEEAM!
text: You clamp your hands over your ears, but the scream gets in anyway. It rattles your teeth, fizzes your hair and shakes a big chunk of your pixel power loose. Little glowing squares rain down around your feet.
Finally the Gremlin King runs out of breath. "Hee hee. Now. I suppose you want my lovely shiny pearl?"

choices.label: "Yes. Give it back!"

king_calm.title: Unshakeable
text: The scream washes over you, but you stay steady. (Or, if you're blowing a whistle as hard as you can, WHEEEEEEEE!) The scream bounces off you like rain off an umbrella.
The Gremlin King runs out of breath and goes bright purple. "That... ALWAYS... works! Fine. I suppose you want my lovely shiny pearl?"

onEnter.message: The Glitch Scream bounced right off you!

choices.label: "Yes. Give it back!"

king_challenge.title: The King's Offer
text: He grins a wide, pointy grin. "You can't have it. Unless... you answer my riddle! Get it wrong and midnight turns your little city dark!"

Then his eyes glitter. "OR... forget the pearl and join us! Be a Gremlin Prince! Free bottle-cap crown! Stay up all night! No bedtime EVER!" Siu Mai's tail puffs up like a bottle brush. "Don't you dare."
A clock on the wall ticks towards twelve. The pearl is sitting right there on his knee...

choices.label: Accept the riddle challenge
Grab the pearl and run!
Accept the crown and become a Gremlin Prince
Put the crown on again. Being a prince sounded fun!

crown_try.title: A Sticky Crown
text: You plonk the bottle-cap crown on your head. It's sticky. It smells of old fizzy drinks. The gremlins start chanting "PRINCE! PRINCE! PRINCE!" and the room starts to go dark at the edges.
Siu Mai leaps onto your shoulder and knocks the crown flying. "Are you MAD? Gremlin Princes never go home!" Your pixels feel a bit wobbly, but you're still you.

choices.label: "Okay, okay. Where were we?"

grab.title: Grab It!
text: You lunge for the pearl just as the Gremlin King tosses it into the air...

test.label: TEST YOUR LUCK

grab_win.title: Snatched!
text: Your fingers close around the warm, glowing pearl. "Hey! No fair!" squeals the Gremlin King, but you're already racing up the stairs to the roof.

choices.label: Run up to the roof

grab_fail.title: Fizz!
text: The Gremlin King hops aside and you crash into a pile of wires. Sparks fizz. Ouch!
"Tsk, tsk. No grabbing. Riddle time!"

choices.label: Listen to the riddle

riddle_right.title: Correct!
text: The Gremlin King's mouth falls open. "How did you... nobody ever... oh, FINE."
He sulks and tosses you the pearl. "Rules are rules, even for gremlins."

choices.label: Run up to the roof

dragon_summit.title: The Neon Dragon
text: You burst out onto the tower roof. The wind howls. The Neon Dragon lifts her great head. She is enormous, made of a million tiny lights, but almost all of them have gone dim.
"Player One," she whispers, in a voice like distant thunder. "Do you have it?"
Below you, the clock begins to chime midnight.

illustration.alt: A huge dragon made of dim lights coiled around a tower

choices.label: Hold up the Pearl of Light
choices.lockedHint: Needs the Pearl of Light

victory.title: Lights On!
text: The pearl leaps from your hands and spins into the dragon's chest. FWOOOSH! Light races through her body (red, gold, green, blue) and bursts out across the city. Every tower, every tram, every neon sign in Causeway Bay and every lantern on Temple Street blazes back to life.

Then the harbour fireworks begin. BOOM! Gold chrysanthemums. BOOM! Pink peonies. The Star Ferry toots, the red minibus honks, the grumpy taxi driver almost smiles, and the sky spells out a word in giant pixel letters: {{name}}!

text.text: And then, one by one, eleven zodiac animals climb onto the roof beside you: Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Snake, Horse, Loulou the Goat, Monkey, Rooster, Dog and Pig. High above, a jade-green shape loops around the moon and waves. It's the zodiac Dragon, finally done with the moon! She swoops down and joins them: that's ALL 12 ZODIAC ANIMALS! The twelve of them light the biggest firework Pixel Harbour has ever seen, shaped exactly like you. ZODIAC MASTER! You're a LEGEND!

text: The Neon Dragon bows her head. "Thank you, hero." Siu Mai purrs so loudly the whole roof vibrates, then hands you a bubble tea with a straw shaped like a dragon.
With a blink, you're back in the Golden Joystick. The machine's screen shows a brand-new HIGH SCORE with your name next to it. Auntie Lam winks and hands you another egg tart.

illustration.alt: Fireworks over a brightly lit pixel harbour with the Star Ferry

then.message: The zodiac Dragon joins you! ALL 12 ZODIAC!

riddle_wrong.title: Lights Out
text: "WRONG!" cackles the Gremlin King. BONG... BONG... BONG... The clock strikes midnight. One by one, the lights of Pixel Harbour blink out, until only the moon is left.
Everything goes black, and you're back in the Golden Joystick. The screen says: GAME OVER. INSERT TOKEN TO TRY AGAIN.
Maybe next time, listen to the clock...
The Gremlin King's cackle drains your very last drop of Pixel Power. ★ 0.

zapped.title: Bopped!
text: BOP! Bolt-Bot's giant rubber fist sends you spinning... and spinning... and you land on your bottom on the floor of the Golden Joystick.
The machine flashes: GAME OVER. BOLT-BOT WINS THIS ROUND.
Next time, maybe try a different idea. Even robots have soft spots (and tummies).
That last bop knocked out every drop of your Energy. ⚡ 0.

gremlin_prince.title: Prince of the Gremlins
text: You put on the bottle-cap crown. It's a bit sticky. The gremlins cheer, and the Gremlin King pats you on the head. "Welcome to the family!"

At midnight the lights of Pixel Harbour go out, and the gremlins throw the noisiest party in history. You stay up all night. And the next night. And the next. It turns out "no bedtime EVER" is actually quite tiring.
Siu Mai sends you a postcard: WISH YOU WEREN'T THERE.
All that partying drains your very last drop of Pixel Power. ★ 0.

illustration.alt: Gremlins partying in the dark

trapped.title: Game Over
text: Your last pixel of strength fizzles out. Everything freezes: Siu Mai mid-meow, the gremlins mid-giggle, the clock mid-tick.

Then the world folds up like a cardboard box, and you're standing behind thick glass, looking OUT at the Golden Joystick. You're inside the Neon Dragon machine. You bang on the screen. Outside, a kid walks past, glances at the machine and says, "Cool graphics."
Somewhere far away, a tinny voice starts to count: CONTINUE? 9... 8... 7...

illustration.alt: An arcade machine in a dark void with a tiny hero trapped inside the screen

out_of_tokens.title: Out of Tokens
text: You reach into your pocket. Nothing. Not one single token.

The world flickers. Big letters scroll across the sky: INSERT COIN. INSERT COIN. INSERT COIN. But you have no coins to insert. The pixels fold up around you, and you're stuck inside the Neon Dragon machine, looking out at the Golden Joystick, waiting for somebody, anybody, to drop in a token.
Auntie Lam did say: never spend your last token.

illustration.alt: An arcade machine flashing INSERT COIN with a tiny hero trapped inside

go_home.title: Home Safe
text: You decide that's enough adventure for one night. Siu Mai sighs, but shows you a glowing exit door behind a fish-ball stall.
You step through and you're back in the arcade, warm and dry. The Neon Dragon machine flickers... then switches off.
Somewhere, a pixel city is getting darker. Maybe tomorrow you'll feel braver?

gremlin_rabbit.title: Not a Bunny!
text: The rabbit turns round. Its ears are cardboard, its fluffy tail is a cotton-wool ball, and under the hood two green lights blink at you. It pulls off its head: it's a GLITCH GREMLIN in a rabbit costume!
"Hee hee! Fooled you!" it cackles. Then it zaps you with a fizzing spark from its fingertips and scampers off into the shadows. (-2 Pixel Power)
Siu Mai shakes its head. "Glowing green eyes! Real rabbits have twitchy noses, not glowing eyes. That's how you spot a gremlin. The real rabbit must be on another path!"
